content:
# Bufkapedia

**Bufkapedia** is the personal knowledge wiki of **Bufka2011** (Alex), the lead developer of **Nuclear Tech: New Horizons**. It serves as a public encyclopedia documenting knowledge, guides, references, and personal notes.

## Purpose

Bufkapedia was created as a central repository for knowledge that Bufka2011 wants to share publicly. It covers topics ranging from modpack development and Minecraft modding to personal interests and discoveries.

## Features

- **Articles** — In-depth entries with full Markdown content
- **Search** — Full-text search across titles, descriptions, and article bodies
- **Public access** — No authentication required to read

## Technology

Bufkapedia is built into the NTNewHorizons website using the same Node.js/Express + EJS stack as the rest of the site. Articles are stored as JSON flat files and rendered as HTML.

## Article priority

When searching Bufkapedia, results are ranked by:
1. **Title match** (highest priority)
2. **Description match** (medium priority)
3. **Article body match** (lowest priority)

---

*This article serves as the canonical reference for the Bufkapedia itself.*

content:
# Nuclear Tech: New Horizons

**Nuclear Tech: New Horizons** (abbreviated **NTNH**) is a Minecraft modpack centered on **HBM's Nuclear Tech Mod**, created by **Bufka2011**. It is inspired by **GregTech: New Horizons (GTNH)** but replaces GregTech with HBM's Nuclear Tech Mod as the core progression driver.

## History

The project began on **September 11, 2023** as *NTM RP*, a roleplay-focused modpack. It went through six generations before being rebranded as *Nuclear Tech: New Horizons*.

## Development

- **Lead Developer**: Bufka2011 (Alex)
- **Team**: Rerserder (Nikita), HiVerse, Xekitan, TinnPott
- **Status**: Active development

## Philosophy

NTNH is completely free and open. No paywalls, no locked content. Built entirely on free, open-source mods.

## Links

- [Website](https://ntnewhorizons.com)
- [Discord](https://discord.gg/wtNVzeE5QB)
- [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/ntnewhorizons)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/NTNewHorizons)

content:
# HBM's Nuclear Tech Mod

**HBM's Nuclear Tech Mod** (often abbreviated as **NTM** or **HBM's NTM**) is a long-running Minecraft mod created by **HbmMods** (or **TheBobcat** / **HBM**) that has been in active development for over ten years.

## Overview

Despite its name, NTM is far more than a nuclear mod. It is a full industrial simulator featuring:

- Complex chemical processing chains
- Oil refining and petrochemical production
- Advanced factory automation
- Radiation mechanics and nuclear reactors
- A hidden storyline and lore
- Numerous easter eggs and references

## Importance to NTNH

NTNH is built entirely around NTM as its core progression mod, putting it in the spotlight in the same way GregTech is featured in GTNH.

## Misconceptions

Most people who have heard of NTM think it is just "the mod where you blow things up with nuclear bombs." In reality, the explosive elements are a small part of what the mod offers. The engineering depth and lore are what make it truly special.
